Limited Entry/Quota Hunts Public Land Use Accessibility Accommodations Commercial Commercial Licenses Commercial Saltwater Commercial Freshwater CLS Online Login Charter Licenses Vessel … s.com State Records Regulations License Requirements Permits Gear Requirements Lionfish as Pets Minimum Size Limit: None Daily Bag Limit: Unlimited Harvest Season: Open year-round These regulations apply in Gulf and Atlantic state and federal waters A recreational fishing license is not required for recreational fishers targeting lionfish while using a pole spear, a Hawaiian Sling, a handheld net or any spearing device that is specifically designed and marketed exclusively for lionfish. A recreational fishing license (unless exempt) is required for all other methods of harvesting lionfish including hook and line. The sale of commercially harvested lionfish requires a Saltwater Products License . Interested in selling lionfish? Chec
